post.title: Snapchat charges rent on your memories. Snapback doesn't.
post.caption: One fresh grudge: Snapchat put old Memories behind a storage plan, so someone built a free viewer for the export that runs entirely in your browser.

segments.gripe: Snapchat charges to keep your own old photos.
segments.quote: In 2025 Snapchat started charging for Memories storage above 5 GB.

cues.cap: Your old snaps, your old photos,

cues.say: [sarcastic] In twenty twenty-five Snapchat started charging
for Memories storage above five gigabytes.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
